comments.rawMarkdown:
If necessary, you can release the full dataset after the main track. Since paper judging will begin before that, one option is to release a small sample of the dataset immediately for judging (e.g. 5% random sample of sequences). 

That way the competition stays fair and the evaluation of the resource can also be done in a verifiable way.

Thanks for hosting the competition @elanlearns and team! I am working on the main track, quite interested with the paper track just curious of the topic idea before dedicating.

If I just want to share a new SFT recipe that would increase Gemma4 model's swe performance would that be a great candidate topic that fits on the main categories?
Given other potential novel ideas such as using code graphs or embeddings, it might wane in comparison. Just looking for your opinion, thanks in advance!

Secondly, in the spirit of fair competition; can we release our dataset until after the main track is over?
